special_instructions: Villagers belonging to the Nellitheertha Kudukattu are requested to bring and hand over their Hore Kanike items at 8:00 AM on 20-12-2026, the day of the Ugrana Muhurtha.
Hore Kanike: Those who are offering Hore Kanike to Sri Devaru are requested to bring and hand over the offerings to the temple before evening on 20-12-2026, the day of Ugrana Muhurtha.
Bhajana: Every day from 20-12-2026 to 30-12-2026, from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM, Bhajana programs will be conducted by various Bhajana Mandalis.
Cultural Programs: On all days of the Mahotsava, every day from 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM, various cultural art performance programs will be held.
Since there is a requirement for Hingara and Bananas for the Nagabrahma Mandala Seve held on 25-12-2026, we request these two items in large numbers from the Bhaktas.

blocks.text: Starting on Swasti Sri Parabhava Nama Samvatsara Margashirsha Masa Shuddha Ekadashi, dated 20-12-2026, and culminating on Bahula Dwitiya, Friday, dated 25-12-2026, at 10:20 AM in the Kumbha Lagna Sumuhurtha, for Nellitheertha Sri Somanatheshwara Devaru,
With the divine blessings of the Honorary President of the Jeernoddhara Samiti,
Sri Sri Sri Vishwaprasanna Teertha Sripadangalu, Adhokshaja Pejavara Matha, Udupi
will be held under the leadership of the Kshetra’s Paryaya Tantri, Edapadavu Seethambettu Brahmasri Vishnumoorthy Tantri, and in collaboration with all the honorable Edapadavu Tantris.
And on the same night, in the divine presence of
Sri Sri Sri Vidyaprasanna Teertha Sripadangalu, Subramanya Matha, Kukke
by Sagri Sri Gopalakrishna Samaga Nagapatri and Sri Krishnaprasad Vaidya, Maddur, Dakke Balaga,
Also, the Annual Jatre will be held from 25-12-2026 to 30-12-2026.

Therefore, we request you to actively participate in the Dharmika and Samskrutika programs to be held from 20-12-2026 to 30-12-2026, receive the Srimudi Gandhaprasada of the deity, cooperate in all ways possible, and become recipients of the complete grace of Sri Somanatha Devaru.
